notes.title: “Give Away: Break Hearts and Win Telegram Premium”
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/9b5aea5e8d91a3d746724a6818183b43682e2e5f.png[/img]

We are launching a fun give away in Broken Scary Skeleton, where your goal is to break as many hearts as possible. The player who breaks the most hearts will receive Telegram Premium!

[b]How to participate:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Launch Demo Broken Scary Skeleton.
[*] Play and break as many hearts as you can.
[*] You can follow the statistics here: [url=https://gdaeon.ru/brokenscaryskeleton]Leaders Table[/url] and here: [url=https://t.me/gdaeon]Telegram Channel[/url]
[/olist]

Prizes: 
5 copies of the full version of the Broken Scary Skeleton game
Telegram Premium for 12 months for the first place.
100 stars for 10 random subscribers [url=https://t.me/gdaeon]Telegram Channel[/url]

Join us and show us what you can do! Have a happy game and good luck!

notes.title: Demo Update: New Challenges in Broken Scary Skeleton
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pS0gbQ0RorM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Hello, Steam community![/h1]

We are pleased to present you the demo update of [b]Broken Scary Skeleton[/b], which brings a number of exciting innovations.

[b]Now you can upgrade your characters after each wave[/b], which makes the game even more dynamic and challenging. But be careful: your opponents will also become stronger regardless of your leveling!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/ab35630d52a49a33a0db39a1ab5829312b798f42.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New skills for each character[/b] are now available for selection after each wave, which opens up new strategic opportunities.
[*] We also changed the interface and effects to make the game look even more [u]attractive[/u].
[*] The character balance has been revised to ensure a more equal and interesting battle.
[*] The conditions for changing waves have also been updated, which adds [i]unpredictability[/i] to the game.
[*] Added [b]a new character[/b], which awaits you in the updated demo version.
[*] Fixed some bugs and bugs to make your gaming experience even smoother.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/f952a6df360372d64893252081ff4f2ba1a7bef0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/33bbf44d9d130d998fa395ae00a52c18a1419e19.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/28b69fd9e5f812625283b72d0f42208a85eb42a6.gif[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560640/Broken_Scary_Skeleton/ style=button]Join us[/url] and check out all these innovations for yourself. 

We are waiting for your feedback and comments!

[i]Have a happy game![/i]
